notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write any of the Jeremiah 39 notes because the research step failed, and I'm not going to fill the gap from memory.

The page fetches for the commentaries (Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes) were all refused. The tool only opens a page once a search has returned its address. When I then ran the searches to get those addresses, I hit my tool limit for this turn and none of them ran. So I didn't read a single source page, and I have nothing to cite.

**If you send your request again (even just "continue"), I'll:**
1. Search the approved sites for Jeremiah 39 commentaries: Enduring Word, Bible Hub's Gill, Ellicott and Pulpit pages, StudyLight, Precept Austin and NET Bible notes.
2. Open the pages the searches return.
3. Look for differences between traditions, for example sermons on Ebed-melech and "because you have trusted in Me" (v. 18) from Reformed, Baptist, Wesleyan, Pentecostal and Lutheran teachers. I'll also check Catholic and Orthodox sites (New Advent, Catholic.com, OCA) and modern scholarship (Bible Odyssey, NET notes on the officials' names in vv. 3 and 13).
4. Write the notes verse by verse with a URL on every point, leaving out anything I can't find.

If you already have links to particular pages, sending them would let me open them straight away and save searches.
